texts.Core_SetupChanges_Intro: Who changed what in Setup, and when, from the Salesforce Setup Audit Trail. Salesforce keeps it 180 days; BarnCRM copies it nightly and keeps it longer. Nothing in Setup changes here.

texts.Core_SetupChanges_Scheduled: This shows changes up to the last copy. New changes are copied every night at 1:30 and kept for {0} days. To see changes made since then, press Copy New Changes Now.
texts.Core_SetupChanges_SearchHelp: Words that must all appear in What Changed, Section, Changed By, Logged In As or Action, ignoring capitals. Try a field or object name, a user, or a permission set.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Duplicates_Steps: Click Standard Contact Duplicate Rule.|If it says Inactive, click Activate.|Do the same for Standard Account Duplicate Rule.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Duplicates_What: To review duplicates, keep the standard duplicate rules active. Give the people who will review them Duplicate Review on the Access page, under Extra Permissions.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Duplicates_Why: A scan applies only active duplicate rules, and Salesforce shows possible duplicates only to users with a Sales Cloud or Service Cloud license.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Email_Steps: Under Access to Send Email, set Access level to All email.|Click Save.|Come back here and click Check Again.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Email_What: Let this org send email, so the error digest can be delivered.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Email_Why: Salesforce sends no digest unless Deliverability is set to All email, and only Setup can change it.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Metadata_Steps: Click BarnCRM Admin, or BarnCRM Metadata Admin.|Click Manage Assignments, then Add Assignment.|Tick the person, then click Next and Assign.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Metadata_What: To save Custom Metadata entries and match sources, you need BarnCRM Admin or BarnCRM Metadata Admin. Either can also be given on the Access page.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Metadata_Why: These saves change the org's configuration, so they need a permission set made for it.
texts.Core_SetupNote_RollupField_Steps: Click the object the rollup totals onto, such as Contact or Account.|Click Fields & Relationships, then New.|Choose Number, Currency or Date to match the rollup, then follow the steps to Save.
texts.Core_SetupNote_RollupField_What: Create the field a new rollup writes its total to before you build the rollup.
texts.Core_SetupNote_RollupField_Why: The Rollup Builder picks a field that already exists, and only Setup creates fields.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Users_Steps: Click the module's permission set.|Click Manage Assignments, then Add Assignment.|Tick the people, then click Next and Assign.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Users_What: Assign an installed module's permission set that this page does not list under Extra Permissions to the people who need it.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Users_Why: Core's extra permissions and every permission set a module lists here are given on this page; any other is assigned in Setup.
texts.Core_SuiteChoice_ChooseInFirstRun: Choose the edition in the Set Up BarnCRM window, or in BarnCRM Settings, General.
texts.Core_SuiteChoice_GivingInstalled: Giving is installed. Its steps are part of this setup.
texts.Core_SuiteChoice_GivingNeeded: The Nonprofit Edition needs the Giving module, which is not installed yet.
texts.Core_SuiteChoice_InstallHelp: Follow Salesforce's install screens in the new tab. When the install has finished, come back here and click Check Again.
texts.Core_SuiteChoice_NoInstallLink: The Giving install link is not published yet.
texts.Core_SuiteChoice_StepDescription: Nonprofit Edition adds Giving to the full core suite. You choose once; it decides which modules show.
texts.Core_SuiteChoice_UnknownSuiteError: Choose the Standard Edition or the Nonprofit Edition, then click Confirm and continue.

texts.Core_TechDebt_DebtIntro: Covers Apex classes, Apex triggers and flows, read without the Tooling API. Not covered: validation rules, workflow rules, process builders, Lightning and Visualforce components, and anything in a managed package. The version limit is the Old API Version setting.
